mapper.select: SELECT p.parents_no ,p.class_id ,p.member_id ,p.parents_email ,p.parents_name ,p.parents_rel ,p.parents_tel ,p.member_no ,sm.student_name FROM parents p LEFT JOIN student_manage sm ON p.student_no = sm.student_no WHERE p.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY p.parents_no ASC

INSERT INTO parents ( class_id, student_no, student_name, parents_no, member_id, parents_email, parents_name, parents_rel, parents_tel, member_no ) SELECT #{classId}, s.student_no, #{studentName}, #{parentsNo}, #{memberId}, #{parentsEmail}, #{parentsName}, #{parentsRel}, #{parentsTel}, #{memberNo} FROM student_manage s JOIN class c ON s.class_id = c.class_id WHERE s.student_name = #{studentName} AND s.member_id = #{studentId} AND c.class_pw = #{classPw} AND c.class_id = #{classId}
mapper.select: SELECT member_id , (parents_name || '(' || student_name || ')') AS parents_name FROM parents WHERE class_id = #{classId}
